result.reason: The redline achieves the preferred 12-month software warranty, removes the willfulness limitation from the malicious-code warranty, and adds a professional-and-workmanlike services warranty. However, it omits the required compliance-with-laws warranty and does not provide the required 90-day services warranty period. The software refund remedy is also available only upon termination after correction is deemed not reasonably possible, rather than as a clear repair, replacement, or refund remedy. Making the malicious-code warranty continuous and leaving the services warranty without an express duration may exceed the specified position. Unrelated Year 2000 terms are preserved, but the dangling phrase 'The warranty shall not apply only if:' and other grammatical issues reduce drafting quality. The margin comment does not cure the operative omissions.
